about_short_description.short_description: Brave Care provides modern primary and urgent care just for kids and access to advice for parents nationwide.

product.name: Pediatric Urgent Care
product.description: Provides walk-in care for non-life-threatening illnesses and injuries such as colds, flu, COVID-19, allergies, asthma, coughs, fevers, rashes, stomach aches, ear aches, broken bones, lacerations, foreign objects in noses or ears, concussions, stitches, and urinary tract infections.

product.name: In-house Services
product.description: Offers on-site labs, pharmacy, over-the-counter medicines, and X-ray services to facilitate quick and comprehensive care.

product.name: Panic-Free Symptom Checkers
product.description: Online tools designed by pediatricians to help parents understand their child's symptoms and get recommendations for care.

product.name: Dosage by Weight Calculator
product.description: An online tool to find the correct dosage of common over-the-counter medications for infants and children based on their weight.

product.name: Home Care Guides
product.description: Provides expert advice for parents to manage mild symptoms at home, written and reviewed by pediatric providers.
